Pricing summary (anchored to projected 1M tokens/month):
- Option A — Annual committed (12 months): $120,000 total (equates to $10k/month) — includes a 12% committed discount and a 30-day invoice net.
- Option B — Usage-based window (12 months, monthly billing): $0.013/token billed monthly; expected ~ $15k/month at forecasted usage; includes a 5% usage-volume rebate after quarter close.
